'''Pat Howlett''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Levittown tournament (21 July)]] on 21 July 2001 with TTO, according to Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2684">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-22-levittown-ny-7-21-01-i-lost-my-palpyd2684/ levittown-ny-7-21-01-i-lost-my-palpy], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 22 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-22-levittown-ny-7-21-01-i-lost-my-palpyd2684/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
